beefs.about: A Negro League version of Casey. Casey gets hurts, and in steps an old Black man, an ex-Negro-Leaguer, who can actually hit the ball.
quotes: A Negro League version of Casey. Casey gets hurts, and in steps an old Black man, an ex-Negro-Leaguer, who can actually hit the ball.

A Negro League version of Casey. Casey gets hurts, and in steps an old Black man, an ex-Negro-Leaguer, who can hit the ball. In 2013 Kevin Kane, a New York City playwright and singer/songwriter, was asked by the Cooperstown Baseball Hall of Fame to write something based on the iconic American poem Casey at the Bat, “but with a Negro League angle”. Kane wrote a new version of Casey called Breaking the Line with the Mudville Nine In 2013
